subject: Cerulean SIG kickoff: attendance, artifact gaps & log sampling
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@cerulean.io>, security@cerulean.io
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Cerulean SIG kickoff: initial times and materials

Hi Samir / Cerulean security team,

Thanks for the intake form you shared — appreciate the detail. We'd like to get a SIG/CAIQ kickoff call on the calendar next week to align scope (SIG vs SOC 2), confirm evidence owners, and hand off log sample requirements. Proposed times (PST):

- Tue Aug 25, 10:00–10:45
- Wed Aug 26, 14:00–14:45

If none of those work, tell us a few windows and we'll accommodate. On the call we'll cover: scope (CAIQ baseline + targeted SOC 2 evidence), required artifacts matrix, and a short walkthrough of how we collect anonymized log samples for the intake.

I've attached two starter files to speed things up: a pre-populated CAIQ worksheet you can edit (cerulean_caiq_initial.xlsx) and a short doc describing log sample formats and redaction guidance (log-sample-instructions.pdf). Please confirm who on your side will own evidence handoff and whether an SRE should join for the log sample section.

Thanks — looking forward.

--
Laura Bennett
Security Intake Lead, Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
Attachments: cerulean_caiq_initial.xlsx (spreadsheet), log-sample-instructions.pdf (PDF)
From: Samir Patel <samir@cerulean.io>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Nadia Reza <nadia@cerulean.io>, security@cerulean.io, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cerulean SIG kickoff: initial times and materials

Hi Laura — thanks, those attachments are helpful.

We can do Tue Aug 25 at 10:00 PST. Attendees from Cerulean will be: Nadia Reza (Head of Compliance), myself (Cloud Ops), and likely one of our SREs (I will confirm name tomorrow).

Scope: our procurement team indicated CAIQ + a focused SOC 2 readiness check (we're not doing full Type II yet). Would appreciate it if you could call out the minimal evidence set for the CAIQ items we marked as "in scope" in the workbook — that will help prioritize.

Two quick asks before the call:
1) Can you include an estimated timeline for when Redwood can deliver sample logs if we hand them over next week?
2) We have a VPN-based environment for some services — can you confirm whether the log sampling guidance covers on-prem/VPN pipelines?

I'll send a calendar acceptance once you confirm.

Best,
Samir
Director, Cloud Ops — Cerulean Health
samir@cerulean.io
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, security@cerulean.io
Date: 2026-08-23T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cerulean SIG kickoff: initial times and materials

Thanks Samir — Tue Aug 25 at 10:00 PST is confirmed. I've sent the calendar invite (Google Meet link in the invite) and invited Nadia and your security alias. Agenda (20–30 min technical + 15 min admin):

1) Introductions & scope confirmation (CAIQ baseline + targeted SOC 2 checks)
2) Evidence owners & deadlines (we'll map to your CAIQ worksheet live)
3) Log sampling: required fields, redaction checklist, and transfer method (S3 upload vs. secure transfer)
4) Next steps & timeline for evidence handoff

To preliminarily answer your asks:
- Timeline: if we receive prioritized artifacts and a 24–48 hour window for log sample delivery, our intake team can process and provide a digest (redaction suggestions + sample verification) within 5 business days. Complex VPN/on-prem pipelines may add another 3–5 business days depending on access.
- The log-sample-instructions.pdf includes both S3 and SCP transfer options and a redaction checklist for IPs/customer identifiers; we can walk through specifics on the call.

Action items for the call: please confirm the SRE name who will own sample collection, and mark the top 10 CAIQ questions you want prioritized in the worksheet.

--
Laura Bennett
Security Intake Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachments: cerulean_caiq_initial.xlsx, log-sample-instructions.pdf

Subject: Follow-up: evidence expectations and next steps

Hi Samir / Nadia — quick follow-up ahead of tomorrow's call. A couple of operational notes and items we'll take on immediately from our side: 

- We'll produce a one-page evidence checklist for the CAIQ items you flagged; that will include exact artifact types we accept (policy PDF, console screenshots, IAM role export, etc.).
- For logs: once your SRE confirms a name, we'll share a small test harness script (one-time) to produce a sanitized sample if you'd prefer not to upload real production flows. See excerpt from Samir's message below for context.

> Scope: our procurement team indicated CAIQ + a focused SOC 2 readiness check (we're not doing full Type II yet).

Open items for the call (we'll own the first three):
1) Redwood to circulate one-page artifact checklist (by EOD) — Marissa
2) Cerulean to confirm SRE and mark top 10 CAIQ items in the worksheet — Samir
3) Redwood to send the small test harness and instructions for sanitized log sample (by EOD) — Marissa
4) Confirm data transfer channel during the call (S3 presigned upload preferred) — joint

Thanks — see you tomorrow.
